name: @nshiab/journalism-format
description: Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on easily formatting numbers, dates, and more.

scripts.all-tests: vp check && npm test && vp pack && npm run docs
scripts.version: npm run docs && git add docs llm.md llms.txt
scripts.test: EXPECTED_SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE=America/Toronto TZ=America/Toronto vp test && EXPECTED_SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE=UTC TZ=UTC vp test test/format/formatDateTZ.test.ts && EXPECTED_SYSTEM_TIME_ZONE=America/Vancouver TZ=America/Vancouver vp test test/format/formatDateTZ.test.ts
